| GET | `/crime-categories` | listCrimeCategories | `date` | CrimeCategoryList | yes | List crime categories |
| GET | `/crime-last-updated` | getCrimeLastUpdated | — | object | yes | Get the latest crime data date |
| GET | `/crimes-at-location` | getCrimesAtLocation | `date`, `location_id`, `lat`, `lng` | CrimeList | yes | Get crimes at a location |
| GET | `/crimes-street/{crime_category}` | getStreetCrimes | `crime_category`*, `date`, `lat`, `lng`, `poly` | CrimeList | yes | Get street-level crimes |
| GET | `/forces` | listForces | — | ForceList | yes | List police forces |
| GET | `/forces/{force_id}` | getForce | `force_id`* | Force | yes | Get a police force |
| GET | `/forces/{force_id}/people` | listSeniorOfficers | `force_id`* | SeniorOfficerList | yes | List senior officers for a force |
| GET | `/outcomes-for-crime/{crime_id}` | getOutcomesForCrime | `crime_id`* | CrimeOutcomes | yes | Get outcomes for a crime |
| GET | `/stops-force` | getForceStops | `force`*, `date` | StopSearchList | yes | Get stop and searches reported by a force |
| GET | `/stops-street` | getStreetStops | `date`, `lat`, `lng`, `poly` | StopSearchList | yes | Get stop and searches by area |
| GET | `/{force_id}/neighbourhoods` | listNeighbourhoods | `force_id`* | NeighbourhoodList | yes | List neighbourhoods for a force |
